svg.title: Horizontal gene transfer
svg.desc: Bacterial conjugation in four steps: 1 contact, the donor's pilus attaches to a recipient cell; 2 mating bridge, the pilus retracts and a pore forms between the cells; 3 transfer, one strand of the plasmid is nicked at its origin of transfer and passes into the recipient; 4 both cells make the complementary strand, so both carry the plasmid and its resistance gene. A simplified, general scheme; details differ between plasmids and bacterial species.
svg.text: Conjugation: a plasmid carrying a resistance gene passes from one bacterium to another
